blocks.text: A CPA in Tampa Explains What Traits are Shared by Successful Small Businesses

Thousands of small businesses are started every year, but a majority of them are nowhere to be found within five years or less. Why is that? There are a number of reasons, but a major force behind startup failure is – to put it bluntly – ignorance. It’s astonishing how often the same mistakes that forced one business to shut its doors can be repeated by new business owners. Learning from the mistakes and successes of others won’t guarantee your business will thrive, but it is an easy way to avoid certain pitfalls.

A [CPA in Tampa](http://www.reliancecpa.com//index.html) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help your new business find the path to prosperity and stay on it. Since 1984, we have helped hundreds of small businesses with tax planning, payroll services, strategy development, and much more. We have the experience it takes to know what not to do as you try to build a business, and we know what traits are shared by successful small companies. These include:

items.text: Good internal and external communication skills
